description_en: Queries the role, type, minor version, and zone of each node in a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例中各节点的角色、类型、小版本和所属的可用区
name: DescribeRoleZoneInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query instance IDs
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the node to query. Default value: 1. Valid values:

0: proxy node

    **

    Note This parameter is supported only for cluster instances and read/write splitting instances.

1: data node
parameters.help_zh:
查询的目标节点类型，取值：
0：Proxy（代理）节点。
该参数仅支持集群与读写分离架构实例。


1：数据节点，默认值
parameters.name: query_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and less than or equal to the maximum value supported by the integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10, 20, and 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页可展示的记录数，取值：10、20、50，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

NodeInfo.description_en: Details about each node in the instance
NodeInfo.description_zh: 实例中各节点的详细信息

CurrentBandWidth.description_en:
The current bandwidth of the node, which consists of the default bandwidth and the increased bandwidth. Unit: MB/s.

You can call the [EnableAdditionalBandwidth]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473771.html） operation to specify the increased bandwidth.
You can also use this parameter to calculate the increased bandwidth. For example, if the default bandwidth of the node is 96 MB/s and the returned value of this parameter is 100, the increased bandwidth is 4 MB/s
CurrentBandWidth.description_zh:
节点当前的带宽，单位为MB/s，由节点的默认带宽和增加的带宽组成。
您可以调用[EnableAdditionalBandwidth]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473771.html）接口设置要增加的带宽。
通过本参数也可推算出增加的带宽大小，例如节点默认带宽为96 MB/s，本参数返回值为100，则增加了4 MB/s的带宽

CurrentMinorVersion.description_en: The minor version of the node

CustinsId.description_en: The ID of the data shard

DefaultBandWidth.description_en: The default bandwidth of the node. Unit: MB/s
DefaultBandWidth.description_zh: 节点默认的默认带宽，单位为MB/s

InsType.description_en:
Indicates whether the node is a read replica. If the node is a read replica, 3 is returned.

If the node is not a read replica, no value is returned
InsType.description_zh:
是否为只读节点，如果为只读节点，本参数返回值为3。
如果不是只读节点，不返回本参数

IsLatestVersion.description_en:
Indicates whether the minor version is the latest version. Valid values:

0: The minor version is not the latest version.
1: The minor version is the latest version.

To update the minor version, call the [ModifyInstanceMinorVersion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473777.html） operation
IsLatestVersion.description_zh:
是否为最新的小版本，返回值：
0：不是最新版本。
1：是最新版本。

如需升级小版本，请调用[ModifyInstanceMinorVersion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473777.html）接口

IsOpenBandWidthService.description_en:
Indicates whether the bandwidth of the node is increased. Valid values:

true: The bandwidth of the node is not increased.
false: The bandwidth of the node is increased
IsOpenBandWidthService.description_zh:
该节点是否增加了带宽，取值：
true：未增加带宽。
false：已增加带宽

NodeId.description_en: This parameter is used only for internal maintenance of instances
NodeId.description_zh: 本参数仅作为实例内部维护使用

NodeType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:

db: data node.
proxy: proxy node.
normal: regular node. This value is returned when the instance runs in the standard architecture
NodeType.description_zh:
节点类型，返回值：
db：数据节点。
proxy：代理节点。
normal：普通节点（标准架构的实例会返回该值）

Role.description_en:
The role of the node. Valid values:

master: master node
slave: replica node
Role.description_zh:
节点角色，返回值：
master：主节点。
slave：备节点

PageNumber.description_en: The number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
